acquisition method: MS/MS was performed in a data-dependent manner using the top-15 adquisition mode.
cleavage agent: Proteins were on-filter digested using the FASP technology (Expedeon) and sequencing grade trypsin (Promega)
collision energy: HCD fragmentation was performed at 30% of normalized collision energy
fragmentation method: HCD fragmentation was performed at 30% of normalized collision energy
instrument: coupled via a nanoelectrospray ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific) to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: coupled via a nanoelectrospray ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific) to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer
labeling: The resulting tryptic peptides were subjected to multiplexed isobaric labeling (TMT; Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany)
mass analyzer: MS/MS spectra were analysed at 30,000 resolution in the Orbitrap.
precursor tolerance: 800 ppm and 0.02 Da precursor and fragment mass tolerance, respectively.
fragment tolerance: 800 ppm and 0.02 Da precursor and fragment mass tolerance, respectively.
ptm: fixed: TMT modification at N-terminus and Lys; fixed: carbamidomethylation at Cys; variable: oxidation at Met, Pro, Trp, His, and Asp; variable: dioxidation at Met, Pro and Trp; variable: trioxidation at Trp

TMT modification at N-terminus and Lys and carbamidomethylation at Cys were selected as fixed modifications, whereas oxidation at Met, Pro, Trp, His, and Asp, dioxidation at Met, Pro and Trp, and trioxidation at Trp were set as variable modifications.
reduction reagent: Protein extracts were obtained from cell pellets using Tris-HCl 100 mM pH6.8 with 10 mM DTT, 2% SDS and boiled 5 min.
reduction concentration: Protein extracts were obtained from cell pellets using Tris-HCl 100 mM pH6.8 with 10 mM DTT, 2% SDS and boiled 5 min.
